findings: The first guest accepted a signed test-agent request after native TDX image and launch verification.
A chunk on the third disk upload did not publish completion within either bounded attempt.

Guest logs showed that CDS still refused startup because Intel collateral could not be fetched. Controller-side proxy reachability and agent attestation did not prove the guest's CDS service was ready.
follow_up: Check guest DNS, proxy reachability and native CDS status before further uploads; explicitly route cluster.local to DNS; retain failed transfer byte counts and use smaller frames with bounded backoff.
